summary.value: Each level chooses a creature Species.

system.description: Each level chooses a creature Species. Action + 2 IP oils a weapon equipped by you or a willing creature (a free attack rides along if the weapon is yours). Until scene's end, when the oil's Species is hit by that weapon the attacker picks one: slow; weak; strip one damage Resistance for the scene; or fill 1 Pressure Clock section (house-added fourth option).
